answer: The summit index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the lagoon queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1479 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the horizon. Honest users pay that once, farms 20 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
